mutation_note: Every mutation was applied to the working tree, the named suites were run with bytecode caching disabled, the expected failure was observed, and the source was restored; a final restore check runs the contract suite, and an interrupt or kill restores the file too. A mutation whose anchor no longer matches the source is reported as SKIP and counted as a failure, so a stale harness cannot inflate this list.

review.decision_source: four independent reviews of G03, each followed by remediation and re-measurement
defects_found_while_remediating: A mutation reported as surviving turned out to be testing the shared alias vocabulary, which both normalizers now use, so mutating it made them agree again rather than disagree. It was repointed at a guard that pins each key.

Two of my own tests asserted the wrong expectation: one expected a bare unsupported_settings string to be interpreted, and one expected a whitespace-only answer to be refused. Both were corrected to the honest behaviour, with controls.
round_4_defects: MODERATE: a terminated capture carrying an empty usage object was accepted as an empty answer, because the guard keyed on the presence of a usage block. It now requires an actually reported token count.

MODERATE: the two adapters still disagreed about stream_terminated for truthy non-booleans. Both now call one shared reader, read_terminated, and the fixture schema reads the field through the same function, so the two cannot diverge.
MODERATE: a single-alias catalog bound an unqualified transcript key to ANY endpoint, including ones the capture never named. It now binds to that one alias and no other.
MODERATE: RecordedExchange.finish_status defaulted to 'stop', fabricating a clean stop for a recorded response that never said how it ended. It is now absent by default.

MODERATE: a test for the incoherent-timing branch never reached it, because its inputs produced equal timings. It now uses two content events with decreasing offsets and asserts the pre-condition, plus a control that a coherent pair is kept whole.
MINOR: the two catalog normalizers used different alias vocabularies (id|alias|name vs id|alias|slug), so one payload produced two snapshots. One shared vocabulary is now used by both.
MINOR: the guard against a bare string in unsupported_settings was untested; a string would have produced one setting per character. A test and a mutation now cover it.
MINOR: a reasoning-only capture was accepted with an empty response. That is kept, and a test now records the decision: reasoning was billed and did arrive, so the grader decides whether it answers.
